newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures mostly up in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures mostly up in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mostly firmer in the after-hours session on Friday, lifted by short-covering, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.4 yen per kg lower to 0.7 yen firmer than the day's close. Benchmark March was unchanged at 134.8 yen. Volume was 11,206 lots.
The market opened firmer, as cautionary views that the market was oversold attracted short-covering.
"Prices could post a modest technical rebound next week, but any gains could be limited as continued rises in rubber stocks has cast a shadow on the market," one trader said.
